about: Station rows for the Niigata stamp books. Orders were checked against the 駅一覧 tables of ja.wikipedia 弥彦線, 越後線, 信越本線, 上越線 and 上越新幹線 (read 2026-11-08); positions against OpenStreetMap station nodes (sources/osm-niigata-stations-2026-11-08.json). All 76 Niigata stations were within 100 m of their node.
